bounded: A unit without a code renders no Cards block. A Cards block asks nothing until it scrolls into view (IntersectionObserver, features/review/recorded/useSeen.ts). The snapshots of a building are read once and shared by its units (one query key per building, 60 s stale time); each unit then sends at most five card list reads and stops at the first scope that lists a card.
decisions: A refusal on any scope ends the walk and is shown; a later scope is not tried behind it.
"No card has been issued for this unit." is said only when the snapshot listing is complete (not truncated, none unreadable); otherwise the block says older or unreadable snapshots were not searched.
An inconsistent row keeps the Verification link (the report says what failed) and has no PDF link.
An expired or revoked row keeps its PDF link, as the task words it; the server decides what it answers.
A missing route is told from a missing record by the API message "This operation is not available."; both carry the code NOT_FOUND.
The PDF link is the published route on the Studio origin (the Vite proxy in development).
The verify page draws its own History panel because RevisionTimeline in packages/ui words its badge as "Chain consistent" and packages/ui is read-only here.
Commit trailer follows docs/next-steps/WORKERS.md section 7 (Claude Opus 5.5), not the task file line.
